title: Seller Performance Standing: Listing-Type Expiry Period and Expiring Points
content:
**Clause.** Every listing-type violation — a listing policy or restricted product violation — expires once the listing expiry period of 6 whole calendar months has run, and the same period applies to both listing types. The points that expire are, for each listing type, the points recorded for violations of that type whose listing expiry period has run, less every point already expired, relieved or reversed on entries carrying that type, never less than zero, and the expiring points of the two listing types are added together.

This is how the expiring points of listing-type violations are found on a Seller Performance Standing record.

## When the period has run

Whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date to the violation's event date. A violation recorded in the last 6 whole calendar months — fewer than 6 whole months having passed from its recording date to the handling date — has not reached the end of its period; a violation from which 6 or more whole months have passed has.

| Hypothetical handling date | Violation recorded on | Whole months passed | Period of 6 months run? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 September | 15 March | 6 | yes |
| 15 September | 16 March | 5 | no |

## The expiring points, type by type

For listing policy, and separately for restricted product:

1. the points recorded for violations of that type whose period has run;
2. less every point already expired, relieved or reversed on entries carrying that type — whichever violation of the type the entry was booked against;
3. never less than zero.

The two results are added together to give the points that expire.

## Worked figures (hypothetical record, handling date 15 September)

| Violation | Type | Recorded | Points | Period run? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| V1 | listing policy | 10 January | 2 | yes |
| V2 | listing policy | 2 February | 2 | yes |
| V3 | listing policy | 1 August | 2 | no |
| V4 | restricted product | 20 February | 4 | yes |

Entries already on the record: a relief of 1 point carrying the type listing policy, and a reversal of 4 points carrying the type restricted product.

- Listing policy: 2 plus 2 is 4 points whose period has run, less 1 point on listing policy entries, gives 3.
- Restricted product: 4 points whose period has run, less 4 points reversed, gives 0.
- Points that expire: 3 plus 0, which is 3.
